description: This file defines a helper class '_parse_proppatch' for parsing PROPPATCH request bodies in a WebDAV server context. It handles XML parsing of request streams to extract property changes, maintaining parsing state and constructing property arrays.

classes.name: _parse_proppatch
classes.description: A helper class to parse PROPPATCH request bodies in WebDAV, extracting properties and handling XML stream parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the parser object, initializes XML parser, and processes the input stream to extract properties.

methods.name: _startElement
methods.description: XML start element handler; manages parsing state when a new XML element begins.

methods.name: _endElement
methods.description: XML end element handler; updates parsing state and stores parsed properties when an element ends.

methods.name: _data
methods.description: XML character data handler; appends character data to current property value.
